title: Latin1 to utf8mb4 on legacy Joomla: a no-mojibake migration
lede: A Dutch agency we work with inherited a 2011 Joomla site. The articles looked fine until somebody searched for an accented name. Here is the routine we used to fix it without mojibake.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of SQL script with utf8mb4 commands, mojibake correction, brass plate, loupe, wax seal on linen.
